english.note: Use this construction when describing that B was brought up by A, especially emphasizing hands-on care until adulthood.

examples.english: My mother handled my upbringing and looked after me from childhood to adulthood.
examples.traditional: 我由阿媽湊大，細個到大都係佢照顧我。
